title: We Sold Our Souls
author: Grady Hendrix
note: conf=0.95; ISBN 9781683690214 matches the Kindle/ebook edition of "We Sold Our Souls: A Novel" by Grady Hendrix, published by Quirk Books, September 18, 2018. The "A Novel" is a subtitle, not part of the canonical title. No series affiliation appears on Goodreads editions listing, publisher, or retailer pages — Hendrix's horror novels (Horrorstör, My Best Friend's Exorcism, The Southern Book Club's Guide to Slaying Vampires, The Final Girl Support Group) are all standalones. Nominated for the 2018 Shirley Jackson Award and a 2019 Locus Award finalist.
